item.title: City of Lubbock accepting applications for various boards and committees
item.description: The City of Lubbock is now accepting applications for several boards and commissions, giving a pathway for Lubbock citizens to be an active part in the city's future.

item.title: City of Lubbock closes 3rd Street for roadwork
item.description: The City of Lubbock announced that it will be partially closing 3rd Street on Monday, March 2 to allow for roadway work to be completed.

item.title: Texas Tech softball goes perfect in Lubbock debut
item.description: After traveling from coast to coast to start their season, No. 2 Texas Tech returned to Rocky Johnson Field for the first time since its NCAA Runner-Up finish. The Red Raiders hosted the Jeannine McHaney Memorial Classic, where they demolished four opponents over a six-game span.

item.title: Lady Raiders get Senior Day win over Arizona State
item.description: For the final time this season, the Lady Raiders stepped onto the court of United Supermarkets Arena. No. 20 Texas Tech halted their two-game skid and sent Arizona State packing with a 56-51 Senior Day victory.

item.title: Yellow Lake Fire burns 50 acres near Shallowater
item.description: At approximately 1:26 p.m., fire crews responded to a structure fire near North County Road 1000 and County Road 5400, just north of Shallowater, that began moving east.

item.title: Lubbock County Sheriff searching for missing 11-year-old
item.description: The Lubbock County Sheriff's Office is searching for an 11-year-old girl, who was reported missing around 6:10 p.m. Sunday.
